us.heading: Who are we ?

growth.heading: Our Growth
growth.subheading: At Marabu.Services, we believe in the impact through numbers. Each collaboration, each strategy, each accompaniment reflects our commitment to transform ambitions into concrete results. Here are some key indicators of our growth:

magazine.heading: Interactive Magazine
magazine.subheading: We combine expertise and innovation to create unique interactive experiences. Thanks to our digital magazine, we engage your audience with dynamic, captivating and designed content to strengthen your visibility and impact.

conseil.heading: Consulting
conseil.subheading: At Marabu, consulting missions are designed to respond concretely to your organizational and strategic challenges. We accompany you with personalized and innovative approaches to durably transform your structures, optimize your processes and strengthen your internal capabilities.

products.name: Performance management
products.hook: For leaders who want to see clearly
products.desc: You run an organization but your indicators don't tell you what's really happening? We implement the right KPIs, regular performance reviews and dashboards. You decide on facts, not impressions.
proofs: GUCE CI — Data Platform opérationnelle (45M FCFA)
CIE — optimisation et économétrie des factures (1,9M)
CADERAC — revue complète du SI (26M FCFA, 3 missions)

products.name: Strategic advisory
products.hook: For leaders at a turning point
products.desc: Do you need to transform your organization, set a new direction or respond to a directive from your supervisory body? We accompany you from reflection to action plan — without jargon, with concrete deliverables you can own.
proofs: La Poste CI — pilotage de la transformation nationale
GUDE-PME — structuration écosystème entrepreneurial (13M)
VITIB — accompagnement stratégique compétitivité (13M)

products.name: Monthly strategic retainer
products.hook: Your Marabu expert available every month
products.desc: Every month, Marabu reviews your priorities with you, tracks market signals and prepares your committees. Like having a strategic director without hiring full-time — 4 to 8 dedicated expert days, 12-month contract.
items: Monthly strategic review and market watch
Direct access to Marabu leadership team

products.name: IT system transformation & review
products.hook: To know where you really stand
products.desc: Is your IT system holding back your growth or is your data not secured? We do a complete review, identify the risks and give you a clear roadmap to modernize without breaking everything.
proofs: CADERAC — revue SI + équipements (26M FCFA, 3 missions)
MSCI — 4 schémas directeurs (CRM, pointage, QR code, site)
DTP — interopérabilité des données de l'État CI (3,5M)

products.name: Process optimization
products.hook: To do better with what we already have
products.desc: Too much time wasted, unclear procedures, repetitive tasks with no value? We map what is really happening in your organization and propose concrete solutions — including automation where relevant.
proofs: GD Couverture — optimisation processus internes BTP
Ocean Transport — plateforme suivi de flotte carburant (1,77M)
MSCI — structuration institutionnelle complète (6M)

products.name: Sector studies & benchmarks
products.hook: To decide with data, not assumptions
products.desc: Do you want to enter a market, understand your competitors or document your sector to raise funds? We produce serious, sourced studies that can be presented to committees or to technical and financial partners.
proofs: Secteur minier CI — étude de marché complète

Financements PME CI — data mining sectoriel

mission.heading: Tasks to perform
mission.subheading: The mission of Marabu is to embody excellence and innovation through concrete and strategic solutions. We position ourselves as a catalyst for transformation for businesses and institutions, accompanying them in their growth, digitalization and sustainable performance. Our approach is based on a fine understanding of current and future issues, as well as the ability to anticipate economic, social and technological changes.
mission.subheading2: Through our inter-mediation, consulting and operational accompaniment services, we build bridges between local needs and global opportunities. Marabu commits to providing tailored responses, with high added value, while placing human, innovation and long-term vision at the heart of each mission. Together, we shape success trajectories, with agility, audacity and impact.
